values.value:
• Properties (⚙): Pick a palette, theme (Light/Dark), grid size (12 or 9 columns), and run-as mode. Switching grid size auto-clamps existing tiles.
  • Multi-Y series: In a chart widget's config, pick multiple Y-axis fields to render multi-series (each in a different palette color). Pie/donut still uses only the first.
  • Use chart settings from report: Toggle this in the widget config to defer to the report's defaults — useful when you maintain chart settings centrally on the report.
  • Filters (+ Filter): Apply dashboard-level filters that merge into every component report at runtime. Validation runs on save against each report's field list.
  • Undo / Redo: The toolbar arrows undo/redo up to 25 steps within the session (cleared on save).
